window_days.description: GH #1249: how far back, in days before the night, a routine is looked for.

min_days.description: GH #1249: distinct local days a question must come back on inside the window before it is a routine.

cosine_min.description: GH #1249: the cosine of two episode vectors at which two turns are the same question, read as the float cosine; the stored vectors are sign bits, so the script compares 1 - 2 * hamming / bits against 1 - 2 * acos(cosine_min) / pi.

tolerance_min.description: GH #1249: minutes either side of a routine's time of day an occurrence may lie.

tz.description: GH #1249: the member's time zone (IANA name). Times of day and weekdays are read in it and every candidate carries it; an unknown name reads as UTC and says so on stderr.

episode_rows.description: GH #1249: page bound of the episode read and of the vector read, both newest first; a full page is said on stderr.

max_routines.description: GH #1249: routines one night puts to the dreamer, most frequent first.

max_triggers.description: GH #1249: spellings of a routine's question a candidate carries as `triggers`.

dream_run.description: GH #1249: the dream run this pass belongs to, carried through the store and the dreamer.

dream_to.description: GH #1249: the night's window end; the window of the pass ends here.

description.purpose: GH #1249: finds the member's recurring questions and has them turned into prewarm candidates. Once per dream run it reads this hive's own store -- the member's turns of the last `window_days` (`episodes`, by `happened_at`) and their episode vectors (`embeddings`) -- groups the turns by cosine (`cosine_min`), keeps a group that came back on `min_days` distinct local days at one time of day (+- `tolerance_min`, read in `tz`) as a routine with an rrule, asks `./dreamer` for topic, query, tool, lead_min and ttl_min of each, and sends what has a `ttl_min` and a tool on `recurring`, one message per audience set.
description.use_when: Inside memory-hive only: `./dream-glue` arms it on route `recur` when the night has booked its receipt.
description.not_in_scope: No clock of its own, no model call for the grouping, no write outside `scratch`, no tool call stored, no acknowledgement of `recurring`.
